# Skills

A collection of skills for Claude.

| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| [code-comments](code-comments/SKILL.md) | A guide to writing better code comments and docstrings — precise, concise comments that explain what the code does and why, and that stay true as the code evolves. Builds on the serre-style skill and adds rules for keeping comments free of change history and unsupported claims, for updating comments during refactoring, and for preserving existing ones. Use whenever writing, editing, or reviewing comments or docstrings, and when refactoring or moving commented code. |
| [serre-style](serre-style/SKILL.md) | Write, rewrite, or review text in the style of Jean-Pierre Serre — precise, economical, well-ordered, and honest about what is known. Applies equally to mathematics (papers, proofs, lecture notes), to code (naming, structure, comments, docstrings), and to documentation (READMEs, API references, design notes). Use when the user asks for "Serre style" or "write like Serre", or asks to write, tighten, restructure, or review mathematical text, code comments, docstrings, or technical documentation for clarity and concision. |
